summary: Two clinics, WhatsApp and a named dentist are good foundations, but there is no proof of results and the booking path leaves your site.

findings.problem: There is no booking form on the page. Make a booking hands off to an external site or opens a popup.
findings.cost: Patients who leave your site to book are less likely to finish.
findings.fix: A short booking form on your own site.

findings.problem: The menu items About Us, Cosmetic Dentistry Sydney, General Dentistry and Emergency Dentistry link to #, and several icon links have no text.
findings.cost: Dead menus and unlabelled icons lose visitors.

findings.problem: No patient reviews or before and after results appear, and the Meet Dr. Michael Tam section is a video thumbnail with no written bio.
findings.cost: Cosmetic patients choose on proof and on who treats them.
findings.fix: Reviews, captioned results and a written dentist profile.

findings.problem: The text has a broken sentence (are.From single-tooth), a misspelt logo (Acaemdy) and Phillips Zoom for Philips. Dr Michael Tam appears with and without a full stop.
findings.cost: Errors on a cosmetic dentistry page lower trust.

redesign: An on-site booking form and WhatsApp for both clinics.
Reviews, captioned results and a written profile for Dr Tam.
